summary: Minnesota resident Carol Bauer captured video of a farmer driving his tractor through his fields as snow fell in Graceville, on November 6. Bauer told Storyful weather conditions this year made it challenging for farmers in west-central Minnesota, leading to low crop production. Many acres were not planted due to a wet summer and fall, and even some hail throughout the year, according to Bauer. "Farmers had to plant cover crops to stop soil erosion or preventive planting instead of a productive crop," said Bauer. "Now we are trying to finish up with wet fall snow. " Credit: Carol Bauer via Storyful
